_quoi: LE RÉFÉRENTIEL DE COMPÉTENCES IA, servi par deux routes : la table des quatre listes déroulantes (GET) et la proposition pour une personne (POST), dont les phrases sont COMPOSÉES à la réponse. Les vingt-deux sections de la nomenclature y entrent aussi : elles n'étaient servies par aucune route avant ce module, et l'inventaire ne les avait donc jamais vues. Les sept variantes de « porte … au-delà de la cible de cette personne » ne sont PAS ici : elles passent par un motif de i18n/sentinel/motifs.json, parce que la liste des familles écartées a autant de formes qu'il y a de parties de six familles — les lister aurait traduit ce qu'une sonde a vu, et laissé en français ce qu'une autre personne déclenche.

texte.Activités des ménages en tant qu'employe: Activities of households as employers; undifferentiated goods- and services-producing activities of households for own use
texte.Activités des organisations et organisme: Activities of extraterritorial organisations and bodies
texte.Administration publique et défense ; séc: Public administration and defence; compulsory social security
texte.Arbitre les usages, engage l'organisatio: Rules on uses, commits the organisation, answers for the arrangements.
texte.Aucune action de formation : la cible es: No training action: the target is met at the declared level, across all six families.
texte.Catalogue « Formations conformité IA » d: The Training hub’s “AI compliance training” catalogue (FORMATIONS_CAT). Titles, durations and audiences come from there; this module adds only the mapping between a course and the families it carries.
texte.Confirmer par une mise en situation, un: Confirm through a role-play, a practical exercise or a conversation with the manager.
texte.Connaître ce qu'une IA peut produire et: Knowing what an AI can produce and the limits it remains subject to: a plausible result is not an accurate one.
texte.Contrôler la qualité d'une production av: Checking the quality of output before relying on it: accuracy, completeness, compliance with the constraints set.
texte.Deux personnes au même niveau déclaré pe: Two people at the same declared level may be strong on “interact” and weak on “assess”: one gets a result fast and never checks it, the other is wary and gets nothing out of it. The module does not paper over that asymmetry.
texte.Dirigeant, membre du comité de direction: Executive, member of the management committee
texte.Déclarer un niveau PAR FAMILLE, ou obser: Declare a level PER FAMILY, or observe the person’s actual output.
texte.Déterminer quand l'IA apporte réellement: Determining when AI genuinely adds value to the work, and what room to keep for human expertise.
texte.Elle accompagne d'autres utilisateurs, d: They support other users, set practices, challenge uses and take part in the shared rules.
texte.Elle choisit une approche pertinente, co: They choose a fitting approach, add context, assess answers and handle everyday risks without systematic support.
texte.Elle connaît les principes essentiels, l: They know the core principles, the possibilities, the limits and the applicable rules, and know when to ask for help.
texte.Elle intervient sur des situations compl: They work on complex situations: design, architecture, integration, security, advanced governance.
texte.Elle met en œuvre les bonnes pratiques d: They apply good practice in simple or supervised situations, with a referent or a procedure.
texte.Emploie l'IA dans son activité, sans res: Uses AI in their work, with no responsibility for arbitration.
texte.Faire valider les cibles par les métiers: Have the targets endorsed by the business lines, the managers and IT before turning them into an HR expectation.
texte.Formuler une demande qui obtient une pro: Framing a request that yields usable output, and refining it: objective, context, constraints, format.
texte.Intègre, sécurise et exploite les soluti: Integrates, secures and operates the solutions.
texte.L'article # du règlement (UE) #/# impose: Article # of Regulation (EU) #/# requires measures to be taken to ensure a sufficient level of AI literacy, taking into account knowledge and context. It writes no scale.
texte.L'échelle et les cibles sont la position: The scale and the targets are the firm’s position
texte.La personne formalise les usages autoris: The person sets out the permitted uses, the controls and the responsibilities.
texte.La personne identifie une situation sens: The person spots a sensitive situation and knows which rule to apply or whom to turn to.
texte.La personne n'a pas de repère sur ce qu': The person has no bearings on what a generative system produces, nor on the rules that apply.
texte.La personne précise l'objectif, le conte: The person states the objective, the context, the constraints and the expected result.
texte.La personne sait dire la valeur apportée: The person can state the value added, and keeps control of the result.
texte.La personne sait expliquer pourquoi une: The person can explain why a generated answer calls for checking.
texte.La personne vérifie les faits, la cohére: The person checks the facts, the consistency, and what requires a source.
texte.Le module calcule un écart entre une cib: The module computes a gap between a target and a declaration. It establishes no competency.
texte.Le niveau # est le plus haut niveau d'US: Level # is the highest USE level on the scale; levels # and # describe a role — passing on, designing. The function and the sector are capped at that ceiling: they raise the requirement, they do not confer the role. The requirement attached to the type of person passes in full, since that is what carries the role.
texte.Le niveau de départ est déclaré, pas mes: The starting level is declared, not measured
texte.Niveau visé : le plus haut des six cible: Target level: the highest of the six targets. Families whose target is lower do not have to reach it.
texte.Observe les pratiques réelles, autorise: Observes actual practice, allows or refuses a use within their remit.
texte.Piloter les usages et les responsabilité: Steering uses and responsibilities: rules, levels of control, trade-offs, support for users.
texte.Production et distribution d'eau ; assai: Water supply; sewerage, waste management and remediation activities
texte.Production et distribution d'électricité: Electricity, gas, steam and air conditioning supply
texte.Relais désigné auprès des utilisateurs,: Designated point of contact for users, between two training sessions.
texte.Règlement (UE) #/#, article # — maîtrise: Regulation (EU) #/#, Article # — AI literacy. The obligation is to take measures; level # is the firm’s reading, not a requirement of the text.
texte.Santé et action sociale : données de san: Health and social work: health data, and generated output that affects a person is checked before being used.
texte.Santé humaine et action sociale: Human health and social work activities
texte.Savoir quelles informations peuvent être: Knowing which information may be given to the tool, and which may not.
texte.Télécommunications, programmation inform: Telecommunications, computer programming, consultancy, computing infrastructure and other information services
texte.Un niveau GLOBAL masque l'asymétrie qui: An OVERALL level hides the asymmetry that matters
texte.Un parcours : l'écart dépasse deux palie: A learning path: the gap exceeds two steps on at least one family, and no single session closes it.
texte.Une ou deux formations ciblées sur les f: One or two courses targeted at the families showing a gap.
texte.Une sensibilisation suffit : les écarts: An awareness session is enough: the gaps are one step wide, at the first level.
texte.n'ajoute aucun palier que les formations: adds no step that the selected courses do not already reach
texte.Écrit les règles, instruit les analyses: Writes the rules, conducts impact assessments, checks.
texte.Édition, audiovisuel, production et dist: Publishing, broadcasting, content production and distribution
